method: Parse 1.x BasePacket/SubPacket/GameMessage framing; for each target c2s opcode, collect ALL emissions across the 54-scenario corpus; if all samples share an inner-body length, compute per-byte-offset entropy buckets (invariant / low / medium / high) and run-length compress invariant regions. The result is an empirical field-layout map: invariant bytes are likely version/opcode-magic constants, low-cardinality bytes are likely enum/flag fields, medium are likely small IDs (action/buff names), high are likely actor IDs / positions / timestamps.
